summary: TeamInvite: captain-issued token satisfying T1's 'team formation by invite link'. Replay control is max_uses/use_count checked+incremented inside select_for_update() (redeem_invite), verified to actually serialize against real Postgres, not just sqlite. Expiry via expires_at, immediate revocation via revoked_at. create_invite/revoke_invite are captain-only. Redemption reuses join_team, so team-size/one-team-per-event invariants apply identically to invite-based and direct joins.

verification.command: uv run --frozen pytest tests/integration/test_team_invites.py (sqlite and DATABASE_URL=postgres)
verification.result: passed both; 9 tests each (captain-only create/revoke, valid redemption, single-use replay rejected, max_uses=2 admits exactly 2, expired/revoked rejected, unknown token rejected, size/one-team invariants still enforced)
app/worker healthy; migration applies cleanly against real Postgres
